tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Replacement & Reconditioning of damaged trash rack panels of SGS intake at Vodenbyle

itemList.description:
Design, fabrication, supply, erection and commissioning of trash racks consisting of a number of panels of suitable height with vertical trash bars welded to structural steel frame at wider interval for intake structure including cost of all materials,machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding finishing,cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and four coats cold applied coal tar epoxy paint and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings. 
Note: The trash rack should be fabricated from structural steel conforming IS 2062.

Removing debris/wooden logs collected in front and under the water of trash rack , cleaning the trash rack grooves with help of divers and dispossing off the collected debris 1 km away from the site. Engaging divers and diving equipments for hooking and de hooking of trash rack panels for removing safely to the top, including cost of diving charges, equipements, trasportation etc., complete as per directions of Engineer incharge.

Providing Hydra crane services for removing debris/wooden logs collected in front of trash rack stilling basin with help of divers and dispossing off the collected debris 1 km away from the site & providing crane charges for lifting and lowering of trash rack panel

Cleaning gates / hoists / embedded parts to expose fresh metal surface for repainting by sand blasting method as per specifications including cost of all materials, labour, machinery, scaffolding, applying a coat of rust inhibitive compound with all other ancillary operations complete.

Providing one coat of primer painting by spraying to structural steel surfaces with Zinc rich epoxy primer of approved quality(with Zinc content not less than 90%) including cleaning the surface, cost of all materials, labour scaffolding etc., complete with all lead and lifts as per the directions of engineer in charge.(Thickness of primer = 40micron)

Providing 2 coats painting by spraying to structural steel surfaces with cold applied coal tar epoxy paint of approved quality and colour including cleaning the surface; repair of shop coat, cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding etc., complete with all leads & lifts as per the directions of engineer in charge.(Thickness of each coat = 150micron)
